title: Work email not syncing on phone
symptom: Work email on the phone has stopped updating
user_description: My work email on my phone hasn't updated since yesterday. It works fine on my laptop.

options.why: Erases everything on the phone for a problem that is usually a sync setting or password.
Expensive and unneeded. His laptop works, so the account is fine.

options.text: Check the phone has data or Wi-Fi, re-enter the password if it changed recently, check sync and battery saver settings, and remove and re-add the account if needed
options.why: Laptop mail works, so the account is fine. A lost connection, an old saved password or a battery saver setting are the usual reasons the phone stops syncing.

options.text: Tell him to use webmail forever
options.why: A workaround that leaves the phone problem unfixed.

hints: The laptop works, so is the account the problem?
What might the phone have stopped doing?
real_world_tip: Email lives on the server, so removing and re-adding the account does not delete his mail.
